$comment: General-purpose query set for the stellar.org source (2026-11-14). Written from the stellar.org sitemap, page text, the record kinds the site search returns, and eval/qa/taxonomy.json leaf names only; no golden case was read. Each answer was confirmed by reading the page (page answers) or the record (audit, tutorial, partner answers). `answers` lists every record that answers the question; a row matches when it is any of them. Page answers match on path; tutorial answers on the `tutorial` slug; partner answers on the `partner` slug; audit answers on a title prefix or report-URL substring. `evidence` is text on the page or record that carries the fact. `bodyText: true` marks a fact that is in the page body but not in its title or search description.
